listenings.text: And now the weather for the next three days. Today it is cold and grey, between nine and thirteen degrees, and the rain arrives in the afternoon, so if you go out after two, take an umbrella with you. Tomorrow is much better: it will be sunny, but it will be very cold early in the morning, only seven degrees at eight o'clock, so put a coat on the children before school. In the afternoon it goes up to fourteen. On Sunday the weather changes completely: warm for October, twelve to nineteen degrees, no rain at all, and a good day to be outside. One last note for the weekend: the mornings are always colder than the forecast feels, so do not leave the house in a T-shirt. That is your weather.

Hello, this is a message about your boat trip on Saturday. I am calling because of the weather. At the moment the forecast for Saturday morning is wind and rain, and when it is like that we do not go out on the water with children. So here is what happens. We decide on Friday evening, at six o'clock, and we call everybody. If we cancel, you have two options: you come on Sunday at the same time, or we give you all your money back, and you choose. If we go, please come fifteen minutes early and bring a warm coat, because on the water it is always colder than in the city, about five degrees colder. An umbrella is no use on the boat, so bring a coat with a hood instead. Thank you, and we call you on Friday.

extra_audio.text: Good morning. Yes, it is very cold today! And it is raining again. Is it always like this in October? What is the weather like tomorrow? Thank you, have a good day.
